svg.title: AOSP cloud attempt: estimated cost against authorized cap
svg.desc: Recorded estimate for the 30 October 2026 bounded Google Cloud attempt: infrastructure estimate USD 6.1723; conservative projection USD 11.4413 including a USD 2 egress allowance and 40 percent tax/FX reserve; authorized cap USD 50. The amounts are estimates, not a settled provider invoice. VM and both disks were verified absent at 22:41:46 UTC and the cost clock stopped.

g.text: Estimate through verified deletion; the settled provider invoice is not available.
$11.44 includes a $2 egress allowance and 40% tax/FX reserve.
VM + both disks verified absent at 22:41:46 UTC. Cost clock stopped.
Source: retained cost-estimate.json and provider teardown receipts.
